scripts.build: npm run build -w @sketch-to-product-views/contracts && npm run build -w @sketch-to-product-views/shared
scripts.2d: npm run build && npm run start -w @sketch-to-product-views/cli --
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck -w @sketch-to-product-views/pipeline -w @sketch-to-product-views/api -w @sketch-to-product-views/cli -w @sketch-to-product-views/web
scripts.bundle:pipeline: npm run build && npm run bundle -w @sketch-to-product-views/pipeline
scripts.bundle:api: npm run build && npm run bundle -w @sketch-to-product-views/api
scripts.web:dev: npm run build -w @sketch-to-product-views/contracts && npm run dev -w @sketch-to-product-views/web
scripts.web:build: npm run build -w @sketch-to-product-views/contracts && npm run build -w @sketch-to-product-views/web
